basic_details.job_title: CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 29 Posts

age_limit.details: Maximum age limit for all posts is 70 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks in relevant subject, NET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018
qualification.details: For all Guest Faculty posts: A Masters degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in relevant subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by UGC or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D degree in relevant subject in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be are exempted from NET. Further, the qualification for guest faculty shall be at par with the minimum qualification for Assistant Professors in Universities as per UGC Regulations, 2018.

salary_details.details: Rs.1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month for all Guest Faculty posts.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CUTN Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUTN Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUTN Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For all Guest Faculty posts: A Masters degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in relevant subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by UGC or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D degree in relevant subject in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be are exempted from NET. Further, the qualification for guest faculty shall be at par with the minimum qualification for Assistant Professors in Universities as per UGC Regulations, 2018.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for all posts is 70 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs.1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month for all Guest Faculty posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN). It is a central government institution located in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the position of Guest Faculty. Various departments have openings for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 29 vacancies available for Guest Faculty positions across different subjects at the Central University of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for CUTN Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date for interested and eligible candidates to submit their applications via email is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for the Guest Faculty positions by sending their complete application and documents via Email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for CUTN Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Guest Faculty posts at CUTN is 70 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Guest Faculty at CUTN?
faq.answer: Selected Guest Faculty will receive a salary of Rs.1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications for Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject, along with NET qualification or a Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CUTN Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Guest Faculty at CUTN?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at CUTN primarily involves an application screening process based on eligibility criteria.
